sentences.en: Juha put a heavy basket on the donkey.
And then he rode as well.

sentences.ar: بس هو حامل السلة على راسه.
sentences.en: But he was carrying the basket on his head.

sentences.ar: واحد سأله: ليش ما بتحطها عالحمار؟
sentences.en: Someone asked him: why do you not put it on the donkey?

sentences.ar: قال جحا: الحمار شايلني، حرام أثقل عليه.
sentences.en: Juha said: the donkey is carrying me, it would be cruel to make it heavier.
